coordinate_calibration_counterexample.meaning: A unit coordinate-speed signal is null in the first chart and timelike in the second. This is an illustrative metric identity, not a calibrated trajectory claim for computational microticks.

born.scaling_interpretation: Common rescaling represents the same quantum ray only under a normalized single-particle amplitude encoding. If registers encode classical field strength or occupation, rescaling can change the physical preparation. These runs diagnose the missing encoding/calibration, not all possible quantum interpretations.

generic_norm_control.interpretation: The ordinary squared register norm is not preserved on arbitrary complete states. This does not rule out a different invariant or a restricted emergent quantum encoding.
